### short description

one-sentence summary of the bug.

### steps to reproduce
1. what you did (exact command / request)
2. what you expected
3. what actually happened

### logs / error
include relevant logs, http request/response, stack traces (redact secrets).

### environment
- bedrock commit: <git sha>
- go version: <go version>
- os: <os>
- relevant env vars (spotify/soundcloud/genius) — redact tokens

### minimal repro
smallest example that reproduces the issue (code, curl, or steps).
